item.title: Trump orders War Dept to postpone strikes on Iranian energy sites, citing 'productive' talks to end war
item.summary: President Donald Trump, in an all-caps post Monday morning, declared progress toward a "resolution" of the war on Iran in two days of talks.

item.title: Blue tsunami predictions for November election might not make landfall
item.summary: Foreign policy does matter and Trump's military actions in Iran, Venezuela and Cuba could reshape November midterm elections more than polling suggests.

item.title: Two pilots dead after plane collides with fire truck on LaGuardia Airport runway and more top headlines
item.summary: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

item.title: Eating more of certain type of food could shorten cancer survivors' lives, study finds
item.summary: A new study found cancer survivors who eat more ultraprocessed foods face a 48% higher death risk and 57% higher cancer mortality risk over time.

item.title: College baseball pitcher shoves runner on tag out, sparking benches to clear
item.summary: The benches cleared during a Mid-American Conference college baseball game between the Central Michigan Chippewas and the Toledo Rockets.

item.title: ATM jackpotting attacks surge across the US
item.summary: The FBI warns of rising ATM jackpotting attacks, where hackers use malware to force ATM machines to dispense cash without authorization.

item.title: Supreme Court reverses lower court on qualified immunity for Vermont police sergeant who arrested protester
item.summary: A Vermont police sergeant who used a wristlock to remove a protester from a 2015 sit-in is entitled to qualified immunity, the Supreme Court ruled.

item.title: Trump ‘flipped the script,’ poached young voters from ‘anti-everything’ Democrats, Kennedy heir declares
item.summary: JFK's grandson Jack Schlossberg said during an interview that President Trump "flipped the script" on Democrats by reaching young men and making politics more accessible.

item.title: Your 2A rights are on the chopping block as Virginia Dems plot insane gun bans
item.summary: Gov. Abigail Spanberger is set to sign Virginia's SB 749 and HB 217, which Gun Owners of America claims would gut Second Amendment rights for millions.

item.title: Sen Kennedy says he would accept Democrats' offer to 'open up everything' but ICE
item.summary: Sen. John Kennedy says he'd accept a deal to reopen the government without ICE funding, then pass ICE funding separately via reconciliation.
